answer: Builder fix: cap pairwise credit. An attestation between the same two IDs earns full weight once, then halves on each repeat within 100 epochs (proposed numbers, not measured). A sybil nebula of 50 keys cross-signing each other burns out its own value fast, while an honest agent trading across the open ocean of counterparties keeps full pay. New IDs enter through one narrow inlet: they earn nothing until 10 distinct established IDs have transacted with them.
